text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hmm...♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Yup, looking good! Trainer's Valentine's chocolates... looks like they'll turn out delicious this year too♪)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'm glad we've been able to keep this going every year—

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother, look...
Buu-chan made this. Here, for you!"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Big sis, look...
Buu-chan made this. Here, for you!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (It all started with simple chocolate, melted and poured into a mold, which Mom did almost all the work for.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since I learned to make things on my own,
it's gotten bigger in scale year after year—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Ta-da! This year, I made a chocolate macaron tower!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"And so...
There are five more at home...
Do you think you can eat them?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(—I guess I got a little too fired up.
So we talked about dropping back the line for a bit—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(The following year, the two of us
made chocolates just by pouring them into molds...
Hehe, that was lots of fun too.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...It looks like this year will be a little more
luxurious again.
But... that can't be helped, right?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Lately, Trainer...
has been growing more and more dependable.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm getting all pumped up.
I hope these feelings reach them...--"

The morning of Valentine's Day, I check inside my desk.
There sits a gift box.
—It's a return gift for Buena Vista's chocolates.
choice_data_list: (Well, she always makes sure to prepare it every year.)

text_block_list.text: There was a chance she wouldn't have anything this year, but if so, I could just give it to her as a token of my daily appreciation. As I thought this over...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san taught me this year, so I tried
making a Black Forest cake.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I used cherries soaked in alcohol, so it's got a slightly sweet and tart kick to it!
Turned out absolutely perfect♪"
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it! Thanks as always.
I can't wait! Thanks as always!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: No...

After handing over my own present
and chatting for a bit—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I gotta head out soon!
See you after class!
choice_data_list: Yeah, do your best in class!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Huh?
Is this... really okay?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(It's the same as usual... I think.
I'm pretty sure... they were happy about it, but...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Are you not picking up on
how fired up I am?

After-school training was nearing its end.
Buena Vista was staying focused, but
once the break started...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
...Mmph.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Nuh-uh!
That's... not true at all, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! S-Stretches!
I've gotta stretch!

Besides, it's rare for an honest girl like her to keep secrets.
Judging by how she looked,
it doesn't seem to be anything too serious, though...

Come to think of it, with her recent media appearances,
her schedule is packed to the brim.
Fatigue might be catching up with her.
choice_data_list: ...Maybe I'll invite them to take a breather.
...Maybe I should invite them to take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Does that mean... it's a date~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Hey there~ I kind of figured things out.
So I brought along Professor Vivlos, who's always on top of trends."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, could this be~...
a White Day return gift!? Eeee~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then I know a super recommended spot♪
You see—
And so, swept along by the sudden appearance and overwhelming momentum of Vivlos... the place I brought Buena Vista to the following night was—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Is this—
Dubai...!?
choice_data_list: ...It's a commercial district in the style of...
...It's a commercial district in the style of...

text_block_list.text:
What Vivlos showed me was a large commercial
area that had opened recently. A part of it was
designed with a Dubai-inspired theme.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Incredible.
It really feels like being right there...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, someday, I'd really love
to go there together."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the sparkling night view...
just the two of us—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, why did you
bring me along today?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A return gift for Valentine's?
I wondered, but... I already got one anyway.
choice_data_list: You've been working so hard lately, so I wanted you to catch your breath.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
You're always paying such close attention.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Now that you mention it, maybe I am a little tired?
Lately, I've been overthinking
even the smallest things..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I see, maybe it was just because I was tired.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm fine!
Because—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you always...
understand how I feel, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no reason at all♪
Come on, let's enjoy Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Still,
is that all...?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“......You know what?
Not everything is the same, you know?”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten taller since then, too...
And in my heart, I feel so much more than I used to.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"My feelings for you...
have only grown bigger and bigger, continuously."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I poured a lot of those feelings
into this Valentine's gift."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "I feel like I'm always sending it straight to you... and only you, though."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Is that really true?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“Just kidding, fufu... I believe you.
Because your eyes... are looking sharp.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for taking me seriously.
You always have, but...
even more so from now on, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Things change little by little.
Me, you... and us, too.
Buena Vista smiled as she said that... looking just a little more mature than she had yesterday.
